payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used for extracting clusters, including the use of k-means clustering on word embeddings trained on Wikipedia articles.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, initialized with 'k-means++' and run for 300 iterations.
The word embeddings used for clustering were trained using the skip-gram model, which improved performance in sentiment classification tasks.
Out-of-domain embeddings, such as those from Wikipedia, were utilized to construct the word clusters, contributing to their effectiveness.
